name: 86-caption-side-empty-cells
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 15px; } table { width: 300px; margin: 10px 0; table-layout: fixed; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; } caption { padding: 5px; color: #1f5266; font-size: 14px; } td { width: 100px; height: 38px; padding: 5px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 2px solid #557887; text-align: center; } .bottom { caption-side: bottom; } .hide-empty { empty-cells: hide; } .top { caption-side: top; } .show-empty { empty-cells: show; }
